evidence.title: Free Color Picker Tool & Palette Generator

name: ColorPicker.com
summary: Free online color picker: choose colors, generate color schemes and grab color palettes from any website.
description: A browser-based color picker with HEX, RGB and HSB inputs and a color chart; pick a color and generate complementary, split complementary, monochromatic, triadic, tetradic, analogous, shade, tint and tone schemes. A Grab Website Colors tab extracts hex codes from a site's HTML and CSS, colors can be saved to a palette, and every color links directly via its hex code in the URL.
contains: HEX, RGB and HSB color picker with a color chart
scheme generation: complementary, split complementary, monochromatic, triadic, tetradic, analogous, shades, tints, tones
grab website colors from any URL by reading its HTML and CSS hex codes
save colors; link directly to a hex color in the URL
